title: heliopsis anomala
intro: Heliopsis anomala, commonly known as false sunflower or prairie coreopsis, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Heliopsis anomala include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which are beneficial in treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
